name: Jesus The Christ
overview: Scripture reveals Jesus the Christ as the fulfillment of God's covenant promises, tracing His divine purpose from creation onward. The opening of Genesis affirms God as Creator of all, setting the foundation for understanding Jesus' role in redemption. The promise of enmity between the serpent's seed and the woman's seed foretells Christ's victory over sin, while God's covenant with Abraham assures that through his lineage, all families of the earth will be blessed, pointing to Jesus as the Messiah who brings salvation to all nations.
